chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Lyon, 2024, the Olympic semi-final: USA against Germany, in extra time. Mallory Swanson passes in behind. Sophia Smith, now Sophia Wilson, bursts past the defender... the keeper rushes out... she lifts it over her. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Sophia starts running before the pass. She races Felicitas Rauch into the space behind and gets there first.

chapters.label: Over the keeper
chapters.text: Ann-Katrin Berger slides out, so Sophia lifts the ball over her, into the net. The USA won gold!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: run into the space behind the defence, then finish before they catch you.
